sources.text: I lose track of customers when calls come in after closing.
Scheduling a second visit means checking three different calendars.
I write estimates on paper and cannot explain why two similar houses get different prices.
A follow-up reminder would help me call back people who never booked.
I need to see which quotes are still waiting for a reply.
The calendar changes while I am on the phone with a customer.
I want the estimate to show what was included before I send it.
We forget to follow up on the old quotes because nobody owns the next step.
I would rather review an automated message before it goes to a customer.

opportunities.title: Make scheduling inspectable
opportunities.hypothesis: A shared availability view could reduce uncertainty while staff arrange a visit.

opportunities.title: Explain the estimate
opportunities.hypothesis: An itemized estimate with an explanation could help staff review and defend a quote.

opportunities.title: Give follow-up an owner
opportunities.hypothesis: A visible next-action queue could help staff review outstanding leads and quotes.

opportunities.title: Keep a human in the loop
opportunities.hypothesis: A review queue for after-hours actions could capture demand while preserving staff control.
